text:
rachel: bringing Ironclad's LoRA merge into sandbox now. early signal: embedding recall on cust_faqs dropped after our OPTQ int4 pass. opening thread to triage.

tom: uplink to quick-evals dashboard https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/1854321999  summary: embed_recall 0.90 -> 0.76, mean cosine delta ~ -0.13. :frowning: 

priya: quick peek at tokenization for a failing anchor shows a boundary shift around dollar/currency and list hyphenation. minimal repro below.

```
orig: "Amount due: $15.00 - due by 04/01"
tokens(base): [210, 652, 4098, 77, 9012]
tokens(ironclad-lora): [210, 652, 4098, 33, 9012]  // hyphen tokenization different, '$15.00' stayed same but surrounding punctuation differs
```

nikhil: worth noting we ran the OPTQ int4 flavor in the merge CI. when I reran without quant the recall drop is ~0.02; with OPTQ int4 it balloons to ~0.13. quant+tok mismatch looks multiplicative.

eval-bot: [auto] quickpack artifact: /artifacts/1854321999/quickpack.json  generation metrics within thresholds; embedding_recall failed (delta -0.14). Reranker passrate: 0.92 -> 0.71.

rachel: thanks. plan brainstorm: (A) add a tokenizer shim at merge-time to normalize hyphens/currency/bullets to adapter preproc, (B) try bnb int8 for customer deploy to see if quant reduces drift, (C) rebuild adapter with prod tokenizer, (D) tiny anchor-finetune on customer's FAQ anchors to re-anchor vectors.

priya: I'll draft a tokenizer shim and a token-diff CI job that flags boundary mismatches between base and adapter. will include small examples for percent/currency/hyphen, and unit tests. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1702

nikhil: I'll run a quant matrix after PR lands: OPTQ int4, OPTQ int4 with fold-v2.3, bnb int8. repro command for the failing set: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model ironclad-lora-merge:v1 --quant optq-int4 --dataset cust_faqs --seed 11 --limit 100
```

(6m)

nikhil: pasted top human diffs from limit=100 run: 
1) Q: "How do I change payment method?"
   base top1: "Go to account > payment methods"
   ironclad top1: "Update your payment method in settings"  // similar text but embedding score lowered, rank drop
2) Q: "What is your refund policy?"
   base top1: "30-day refund window"
   ironclad top1: "Refunds are processed within 30 days"  // phrasing changed, reranker fails threshold
3) Q: "Do you bill in USD?"
   base top1: "Yes, we bill in USD by default"
   ironclad top1: "Default billing currency: USD"  // small vector drift pushes answer off top2

rachel: downstream reranker has a strict cutoff; these shifts are causing end-to-end failures. add reranker_passrate and embedding_recall to the quickpack baseline and compare int4 vs int8. if token shim + int4 still fails, consider anchor-finetune quick repair.

priya: PR opened with tokenizer shim + CI tests for token boundaries. also adding a small script to generate a token-diff histogram for quickpacks. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1702

nikhil: once PR merges i'll re-run the matrix and also test fold-v2.3 vs fold-v2.1 layernorm folding to see numerical sensitivity during OPTQ. will post artifacts.

eval-bot: [auto] updated quickpack recipe per request: now emits embedding_recall, reranker_passrate, token-diff histogram.

rachel: timeline: get tokenizer shim PR within 24h, run quant matrix (int4/int8/folding) on canary with new quickpack, evaluate small anchor-finetune (100 steps) if needed, aim for mitigation decision in 48h. filing INF-450 for CS handoff and internal tracking. tagging @eng-ml and @customer-success. :thumbsup: 

priya: +1. I'll include a minimal reproducer and a short doc in the PR describing why token boundaries amplify after quant to help onboard newer engineers.

rachel: great, please report back with final quickpack artifact and a recommendation. thanks team.
